== Unsouled ==
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">2</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Certain [[elixirs]] are used to stabilize a core after reaching [[Iron stage]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c12">''Unsouled'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|It is said that twenty [[elixirs]] are needed to get close to the [[Jade stage]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c12" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Ghostwater ==
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">2</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|The [[elixirs|elixir]] can be frozen into ice to make an ordinary drink glow purple.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6">''Ghostwater'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|One dose of the [[elixirs|elixir]] costs a thousand [[high-grade scales]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6" />}}</li>
</ul></div>
